chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 613: The Patient Work of Eliminating Hidden Threats
chapter_meta_description: Han Li settles into a new hideout, beginning the slow, painful process of expelling the Wind Spirit Restriction and refining the Crying Soul Pearl. A chapter about the unsung maintenance behind survival in the Mortal Stream.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality – Chapter 613: Silent Fortification
og_description: Han Li carves a new cave dwelling and starts the agonizing task of expelling the Wind Spirit Restriction from his body. A quiet chapter about the hidden costs of safety.
twitter_title: RMJI Ch.613 – The Hidden Labor of a Survivor
twitter_description: No big battles, just sweat and patience. Han Li spends months forcing evil qi out of his body and refining a beast’s soul pearl. This is the true face of cultivation.

lore_anchors.definition: A lingering hidden energy attack that damages meridians from within; Han Li uses crude mana expulsion to remove it.
A weak but easy-to-cultivate ice-element technique given to Han Li by Mu Peiling.
A specialized formation capable of concealing spiritual energy fluctuations, used by Han Li to hide his cave dwelling.
A rare spirit beast with the ability to consume ghostly yin energy and souls; its internal pearl is called the Crying Soul Pearl.
A condensed pearl inside the Crying Soul Beast's belly, refining it grants control but risks backlash and severe headaches.
A rare sentient spirit herb essential for Nascent Soul formation.
Pure Yang lightning used by Han Li to contain the Chaotic Evil Qi.
The ethereal form of the Wind Spirit Restriction, highly corrosive to meridians.
A specific spirit herb used to accelerate the growth of Gold Devourer Beetles.
A low-ranking disciple role responsible for external duties, considered low-talent but functional.
